name: App icon (rendered from SVG layers, Icon Composer ready)
description: Editable square SVG icon layers kept in the project and an opaque 1024 px AppIcon rendered from them locally; import the layers into Icon Composer for a layered icon.

cost.note: Local rendering with the bundled resvg renderer; Icon Composer ships with Xcode

usage: No code needed. The project gets AppIcon in Resources/Assets.xcassets and editable layers in Resources/IconLayers (excluded from the build). Do not reference the icon from Swift.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify app-icon` on a Mac with XcodeGen.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
